svg.aria-label: What's in the box. In the box, three groups and a vocabulary. Workers: a worker is a private, user-scoped resource naming the singleton flow that runs it, standard workers projected from files, fork, FIX-1788; the worker contract, FIX-1789; user data per org, FIX-1790; the library of templates copied into a user's scope, FIX-1795. Coordinators: delegates in session state, four routing policies, one answer per delegate, a routing record, FIX-1791; declared in WORKER.md, old MAILBOX.md refused, FIX-1792. Projects: private or shared, workstreams with one owner each that the org reads and the owner writes, a project coordinator per user, rooms removed, FIX-1793; tasks down the owner's chain, run as the owner, FIX-1794. One vocabulary, FIX-1796. Composed from what ships: private sessions; session, user and org scopes; projected collections; task boards shared down a lineage; the admission contract and door; a task's named assignee. The app's: its standard install, the files every user starts with, and its users and orgs. Owned elsewhere: long-lived session memory, FIX-1775, and the inventory's calls, FIX-1787. Not built, below a fence: channels, user-to-user communication, transcript resources, files as migrations, removing flow instances and owner pins, a Layer 1 worker, coordinator, project or workstream, a second worker store or registry, a memory field or graph, a session shared between users.
